messages:
zoe (Marketing): Ok team, pushing the near-final blog draft. Need: hero lock, benchmark phrasing, gated webinar + Jupyter kit, and HubSpot + Mixpanel wiring. Target soft-launch Tue AM.
micah (Product): Quick read. We should avoid absolute 'Xx' claims in the hero. Suggest headline that signals SLA-readiness and a subhead with med/p95 deltas. I'll drop exact test notes in the appendix (synthbench v2, 8xA100, seq=512).
tara (Growth): For CTAs: primary = 'Book a demo' (sales), secondary = 'Register for webinar + get the Jupyter kit' (gated). We'll route webinar registrants to a separate nurture track. Also propose a tiny gated asset: Jupyter notebook + results.csv so engineers can reproduce.
samir (Design): Uploaded two hero comps: tight-console.png and hero-snapshot-wide.png. Prefer tight-console for mobile-first. Small ask: shorten headline to one strong line. I'll update visuals after copy final.
zoe (Marketing): Headline options in doc: A) 'Production latency you can bank on' B) 'Lower p95, predictable at scale' Which leans wider audience?
micah (Product): B is explicit for eng buyers. Maybe combine: 'Lower p95 for production workloads.' Keep subhead with numbers: '45% lower median; 32% lower p95 vs baseline*'. Add footnote about baseline config in appendix.
tara (Growth): CTA copy variants I'll test: 1) 'Get the Jupyter kit' 2) 'Claim the benchmark kit' Primary CTA on desktop = demo, hero secondary = kit modal. Traffic split 60/40 demo/kit for launch window.
lina (Growth Ops): HubSpot + Mixpanel wiring plan: two HS lists -> 'launch_demo' and 'launch_kit_webinar'; utm_campaign=launch-q2-curation; Mixpanel events: 'article_view', 'kit_download', 'demo_request'. Lead scoring: +35 kit, +60 demo, threshold 70 to SDR. I'll paste the HS embed snippet and tracking params in the doc.
zoe (Marketing): Also want to include a customer quote in the middle that humanizes the bench. Does anyone have a short quote that can be used?
micah (Product): We have a permissive quote from beta customer (ops team): 'Dropped tail latency during peak by half, made our bursty traffic predictable.' I'll add with attribution.
samir (Design): I updated hero mock to include a small inline sparkline and the quote CTA below. Visuals locked pending copy.
tara (Growth): Webinar scheduling: propose Wed 08:30 PT to be APAC-friendly; we'll run a shorter 30-minute demo + Q&A. Kit delivered immediately after registration.
lina (Growth Ops): I'll configure the HS workflow to send kit + a follow-up email 24h later with demo CTA. Also will record Mixpanel UTM mapping so growth can segment.
preview-bot: preview build scheduled for 2026-04-07T08:30:00Z for thread 1799999999
zoe (Marketing): Timeline recap: copy freeze 17:00 PT today, design lock 18:00 PT, HS wiring 20:00 PT, preview Wed 08:30 PT. If you edit the doc, drop a short note here. :seedling:
